checkpoint.title: The Elite Four's first room: Lorelei

events.why: the precondition for Lorelei: the lead at least Lv51, pokeguy's Blastoise here (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md lorelei; the Route 22 rival takes it from 49 to 51)
from the Mart's counter north to below the League's door (4, 1), past the door guard (5, 3), who only talks when spoken to
onto the door (4, 1), the warp into Lorelei's room at its south entrance (6, 12)
the room's OnFrame script (PokemonLeague_EventScript_EnterRoom) walks the player five tiles north from (6, 12) to (6, 7) and closes the entrance behind; no text
a tile north to (6, 6), facing Lorelei (6, 5)
Lorelei (6, 5): her intro, then the battle (trainerbattle_no_intro)

Lorelei (TRAINER_ELITE_FOUR_LORELEI): Dewgong Lv52, Cloyster Lv51, Slowbro Lv52, Jynx Lv54, Lapras Lv54, two Full Restores; fought by pokeguy's policy C2 (goal-based-setup: Sp. Atk +4 by X Specials, X Speed until faster, Guard Spec first against an accuracy drop; the doc's lorelei row, 94.3% at 159/159); foe_threats are the rows PokemonSimulation's player-strategy planning_risk() gives for each foe leading against the doc's lorelei entry state (159/159), as 19.01's: the 80th percentile of the foe's move choice, its mean, its worst case and its worst normal hit. Lapras's worst case is 78. Then her door north (6, 2) opens

checkpoint: Starts at Indigo Plateau's Mart counter, where 20.01a ends. A boss battle is its own checkpoint (user, 2026-11-12): the walk in and Lorelei's fight. PokeGuy has this fight at 1:46:37 (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, lorelei) at 159/159 HP; 19.05's heal is that entry.
The League rooms are one-way: the entrance closes behind the player, and the next room's door opens only when the room's trainer is beaten.
Ends in front of Lorelei at (6, 6) facing north, saved there (the League lets the player save): 20.02 walks through her door north to Bruno.
